String.string:
[EN] Come, Gatekeeper, and protect me!
[ES] ¡Ven, Gatekeeper, y protégeme!

[EN] Protect me, my warden!
[ES] ¡Protégeme, mi warden!

[EN] Absorbing the warden is making Banyakas unstable!
[ES] ¡Absorber al warden está volviendo inestable a Banyakas!

[EN] You cannot defeat me!
[ES] ¡No puedes derrotarme!

[EN] Ghilliedhus come to Banyakas's aid.
[ES] Los Ghilliedhus acuden en ayuda de Banyakas.

[EN] Banyakas becomes calm when the Dominolith is destroyed.
[ES] Banyakas se calma cuando el Dominolith es destruido.

[EN] Activate Normal Mode (Temporary Message)
[ES] Activar Modo Normal (Mensaje temporal)

[EN] Protect me while I recover.
[ES] Protégeme mientras me recupero.

[EN] Hold off the dark wardens!
[ES] ¡Contén a los celadores oscuros!

[EN] The Guardian has recovered 25% health.
[ES] El Guardián ha recuperado el 25% de salud.

[EN] The Guardian has recovered 50% health.
[ES] El Guardián ha recuperado el 50% de salud.

[EN] The Guardian has recovered 75% health.
[ES] El Guardián ha recuperado el 75% de salud.

[EN] The Guardian has recovered fully!
[ES] ¡El Guardián se ha recuperado por completo!

[EN] I awaken!
[ES] ¡Despierto!

[EN] The dark warden goes berserk!
[ES] ¡El celador oscuro entra en furia!

[EN] Do not interfere with us!
[ES] ¡No te interpongas en nuestro camino!

[EN] I have regained enough power to destroy the coercive shard!
[ES] ¡He recuperado suficiente poder para destruir el fragmento coercitivo!

[EN] You protected the Guardian!
[ES] ¡Protegiste al Guardián!

[EN] I am too injured to move. You must protect me.
[ES] Estoy demasiado herido para moverme. Debes protegerme.

[EN] Banyakas sustains a serious injury and stops moving.
[ES] Banyakas sufre una grave herida y deja de moverse.

[EN] As the coercive shard shatters, the mad sporewalker appears.
[ES] Mientras el fragmento coercitivo se hace añicos, aparece el caminante de esporas enloquecido.

[EN] You protected the Gatekeeper!
[ES] ¡Protegiste al Guardián de la puerta!

[EN] I'm all right. Go help the petralisks.
[ES] Estoy bien. Ve a ayudar a los petralisks.

[EN] Thank you for helping me. You must help Banyakas.
[ES] Gracias por ayudarme. Debes ayudar a Banyakas.

[EN] The last of Banyakas's wardens is about to be enthralled. We have to do something.
[ES] El último de los celadores de Banyakas está a punto de ser subyugado. Tenemos que hacer algo.

[EN] Can you protect the Guardian while he recovers? He's behind me. Hurry!
[ES] ¿Puedes proteger al Guardián mientras se recupera? Está detrás de mí. ¡Date prisa!

[EN] The dark wardens collapse as the hypnotic stone is destroyed.
[ES] Los guardianes oscuros colapsan al destruir la piedra hipnótica.

[EN] The entrance will close soon.
[ES] La entrada se cerrará pronto.

[EN] The Gatekeeper has been dominated!
[ES] ¡El Gatekeeper ha sido dominado!

[EN] The Guardian has been dominated!
[ES] ¡El Guardian ha sido dominado!

[EN] That's enough!
[ES] ¡Ya basta!

[EN] Now that the Dominolith is shattered, Banyakas should soon return to his senses.
[ES] Ahora que el Dominolith está destrozado, Banyakas debería volver en sí pronto.

[EN] Thank you for protecting our forest. Let me give you this small gift on Banyakas's behalf.
[ES] Gracias por proteger nuestro bosque. Permíteme darte este pequeño regalo de parte de Banyakas.

[EN] Now that the Dominolith is shattered and Banyakas is injured, he will soon return to his senses.
[ES] Ahora que el Dominolith está destrozado y Banyakas está herido, pronto volverá en sí.

[EN] Allow me to present you with this small gift on Banyakas's behalf.
[ES] Permíteme presentarte este pequeño regalo de parte de Banyakas.

[EN] Thank you very much.
[ES] Muchas gracias.

[EN] Even with their minds enchanted, the Gatekeeper and Guardian tried to protect Banyakas. They will be missed.
[ES] Aun con sus mentes encantadas, el Gatekeeper y el Guardian intentaron proteger a Banyakas. Se les extrañará.

[EN] Wave incoming!
[ES] ¡Oleada entrante!
